COLLEGE PROFILE

About the college

Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya Adarsha Mahavidyalaya (PDUAM), Tulungia is a
Model College established under the co-venture of the Central Government and
the Government of Assam. The college is an outcome of the centrally sponsored
scheme named "Rashtriya Uchchattar Shiksha Abhiyan (RUSA)" launched in 2013
by the Ministry of Human Resource Development, Government of India which aims
at providing strategic funding in higher educational institutions throughout the
country. Funding is provided by the Central Ministry through the State
Governments and Union Territories, which in coordination with the Central Project
Appraisal Board, monitor the academic, administrative and financial
advancements taken under the scheme.

       The college was inaugurated on 30th August 2017 by Dr. Himanta Biswa
Sarma, the then Honourable Health, Finance & Education Minister, Govt. of Assam.
The academic session commenced on 31st August 2017 and since then it has been
functioning as a Model College to inculcate higher education among the rural
masses of Bongaigaon district of Assam. Presently, the college has a teaching
strength of Fifty-Two teachers serving in the three streams i.e. Commerce, Science
and Arts under different departments, viz., Accountancy, Commerce (Finance),
Management, English, Environmental Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Assamese,
Information Technology, Physics, Chemistry, Botany, Zoology, Education, History,
Economics, Political Science and Sociology. Besides, the college has a Central
library and a Computer laboratory. In addition to the teaching staff, there are ten
non- teaching staff in different cadre. PDUAM, Tulungia is a residential college
offering hostel accommodation for girl students only.




          The college is affiliated under Gauhati University. PDUAM, Tulungia was
accorded UGC recognition (2f status) in the year 2020 and it had also achieved the
distinction of B++ Accreditation (CGPA 2.77) by NAAC in its very first cycle of NAAC
Assessment in 2024.

Institutional participation in NIRF and AISHE survey

The National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) is an initiative launched in the
year 2015 by the Ministry of Education, Government of India to create a
transparent, data-driven system for comparing Indian Universities and colleges.

      Every year, thousands of institutions submit their data and NIRF evaluates
them using specific parameters. The parameters broadly cover- “Teaching,
Learning and Resources,” “Research and Professional Practices,” “Graduation
Outcomes,” “Outreach and Inclusivity,” and “Perception”. PDUAM, Tulungia has
been consistently participating in the NIRF assessment cycle since the year 2024.

       Likewise, the All India Survey on Higher Education (AISHE) under the
Ministry of Education, Government of India is an annual web-based survey of the
higher educational institutions of the country. The primary objective of AISHE is to
portray the status of higher education in the country by collecting comprehensive
data on various parameters such as student enrolment, programmes offered,
examination results, infrastructure, faculty details, and financial information.

       The data uploaded by the college contributes to policy formulation,
planning, and development of the higher education sector at the national level.
Through active participation in AISHE, the college ensures transparency and
accountability while strengthening the national database on higher education.
Since its establishment, PDUAM, Tulungia has been regularly participating in the
AISHE survey and the AISHE Code of the college is C-59837.

Best practices of the institution

The Best Practice Implementation Committee, PDUAM, Tulungia is an initiative
undertaken by the faculty members of the college to contribute towards the
development of the learner community. It was formed in the academic session
2018-19 to provide financial assistance to the poor and meritorious students of the
college out of the monthly contributions made by the members of the committee.
The main objective of the committee is to motivate the students belonging to the
economically marginalized section of the society to excel in their studies by
recognising their talents. The deserving students are awarded with an Educational
Grant along with an Appreciation letter in the Annual Freshmen Social Meet of the
college.

         As an extension of this noble initiative, individual departments of the
college also felicitate and award their students who secure letter marks or highest
percentage in their respective subjects at the event of Annual Freshmen Social
Meet.

FOUR-YEAR UNDERGRADUATE PROGRAMME (FYUGP) COURSE DETAILS

Under NEP 2020, as per the Gauhati University Four-Year Undergraduate
Programme (GU-FYUGP), PDUAM, Tulungia offers Bachelor’s Degree in three
streams, namely, B. Com (in Major discipline), B.Sc (in Major and Minor
disciplines) and B.A (in Major and Minor disciplines).

      The complete FYUGP consists of 8 semesters, to be completed in a minimum
of 4 academic years. Each academic year has two semesters. The FYUGP
curriculum is divided into two parts — (i) Core Courses and (ii) Common Courses.
The Core Courses constitute Majors and Minors. Whereas, the Common Courses
include Ability Enhancement Courses (AEC), Multi-disciplinary Courses (MDC),
Value-added Courses (VAC), Skill Enhancement Courses (SEC) and Internship
which are to be studied by all students of FYUGP.

       The successful completion of a GU-FYUGP programme (B. Com/B.Sc./B. A.)
depends on the student’s earning of a minimum number of Credits specified for the
programme. Credit is a unit of measurement of the course work. Each semester has
a minimum credit allocation of 22, totaling the minimum credit allocation for a 3-
year programme to 120 credits. With the fourth year, the minimum credit
requirements become 160. A student can, however, earn up to a maximum of 132
credits in a 3-year programme and 176 by the fourth year.

It should be noted that any certificate / diploma / degree is awarded only if the
